edge_cases: Missing or malformed template files cause test failures.
Unicode conflict resolution can be overridden by providing a different resolver.
Expressions that raise errors (syntax, division by zero) are expected to propagate specific exceptions.
Path traversal attempts using leading underscores raise NotFound.
Boolean HTML attributes are tested for correct omission or inclusion based on truthiness.
Batch iteration and loop constructs are verified with empty and non‑empty collections.
contract.intent: Run a suite of unit tests that verify the behavior of Zope PageTemplate rendering using the Chameleon engine, including handling of loops, conditionals, Unicode, security, and error cases.
invariants: Each test restores the original security policy in tearDown.
Templates are re‑initialized before each assertion.
No external files are written; all I/O is read‑only on test fixtures.
The provided utility for Unicode conflict resolution is always available.
The test runner always executes in a placeless (isolated) component setup.
All assertions expect the rendered output to be exactly the HTML stored in the expected files.
io_behavior: Reads template source files from the test data directory.
Writes template source into in‑memory PageTemplate objects.
Compares rendered HTML output against expected files and reports mismatches.
Prints unittest progress and results to standard output.
Exits with a zero status on success and non‑zero on failure.
Raises specific exceptions (ExpressionError, NotFound, ZeroDivisionError) when test cases trigger them.

side_effects: Registers temporary component utilities and adapters in the Zope component registry.
Installs a stub security policy for the duration of the tests.
Modifies global state of the SecurityManager (policy replacement).
Potentially caches compiled templates in memory.
Leaves the component registry altered only within the test process.

rationale: The program implements the full Zope PageTemplate test suite, registers required adapters, installs a stub security policy, reads templates read‑only, writes to in‑memory PageTemplate objects, renders and compares HTML, and provides the __main__ entrypoint. All listed invariants and I/O behaviors are satisfied, and the majority of edge‑case tests from the contract are present (expression errors, NotFound traversal, boolean attributes, batch loops, Unicode handling, etc.).
